capabilities: Show an autocomplete menu on tags: and tag: lines
Suggest tags without a # prefix in frontmatter
intentEvidence: Obsidian only shows the tag autocomplete with a # character, but if you use a # character in the tags:
problem: Obsidian only offers tag autocomplete with a # character, which cannot be used in the frontmatter tags field without breaking the tag, so users have to delete the # after autocompleting.
summary: Autocomplete plugin that shows tag suggestions in the YAML frontmatter tags field while typing.
